mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_task (tenant_id, task_name, execute_type, cron_expr, rule_scope, rule_snapshot_json, status, target_level, asset_type_filter, total_host_count, success_count, fail_count, creator, start_time, finish_time, protection_level_id) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{taskName}, #{executeType}, #{cronExpr}, #{ruleScope}, #{ruleSnapshotJson}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{targetLevel}, 3), #{assetTypeFilter}, #{totalHostCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{creator}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{protectionLevelId})
INSERT INTO baseline_task_host (tenant_id, task_id, host_id, status, result_summary, scan_time) VALUES (COALESCE(#{tenantId}, 0), #{taskId}, #{hostId}, #{status}, #{resultSummary}, #{scanTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline_task SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, finish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('FINISHED', 'FAILED') THEN NOW() ELSE finish_time END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE baseline_task SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, finish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('FINISHED', 'FAILED') THEN NOW() ELSE finish_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, task_name, execute_type, cron_expr, rule_scope, rule_snapshot_json, status, target_level, asset_type_filter, total_host_count, success_count, fail_count, creator, create_time, start_time, finish_time, protection_level_id FROM baseline_task WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, host_id, status, result_summary, scan_time, create_time FROM baseline_task_host WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND host_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_task_host WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status NOT IN ('FINISHED', 'FAILED')
SELECT t.rule_scope FROM baseline_task t JOIN baseline_task_host th ON th.task_id = t.id WHERE th.host_id = #{hostId} ORDER BY th.id DESC LIMIT 1
